SELECT event_id, event_time, src_hostname, process_name, file_path, hash_sha256, user_name, class_uid, activity_id, action, outcome FROM aisoc.raw_events
WHERE tenant_id = 'f6a5c700-69b8-44fc-8238-609362fb1a9f' AND src_hostname = 'DEMO-FIN-11'
AND event_time >= toDateTime64('2026-10-25 03:29:00.000000', 6, 'UTC')
AND event_time < toDateTime64('2026-10-25 03:34:00.000000', 6, 'UTC') AND class_uid = 1007 AND process_name != ''
ORDER BY event_time, event_id LIMIT 21
